description: This file contains helper functions and classes used in creating a software release, including git command utilities, commit parsing, and GitHub integration.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Represents a git commit with associated metadata such as hash, author, title, and pull request number.

methods.name: yesOrNoPrompt
methods.description: Prompts the user with a yes/no question until a valid response is received.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its standard output decoded as UTF-8.

methods.name: run_cmd_error
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its standard error decoded as UTF-8.

methods.name: tag_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific git tag exists locally.

methods.name: get_commits
methods.description: Retrieves and parses commit information associated with a specific git tag.

methods.name: get_github_name
methods.description: Fetches the full name of a GitHub user given their username, using a GitHub client.
